functionalReqs: Place market, limit and stop-loss orders
Order lifecycle: open → partially filled → filled / cancelled / rejected
hints: Which checks must pass before an order goes to the exchange?
Price updates fan out to watchlists and stop-loss triggers: Observer.

Account (funds, holdings), Order hierarchy (Market, Limit, StopLoss) with State, OrderValidator chain (funds, holdings, market hours), ExchangeGateway interface, StockPriceFeed (Subject) with Watchlist and StopLossMonitor observers, fund blocking on order placement, per-account locks.
nonFunctionalReqs: Funds and holdings never go negative
Concurrent orders on the same account handled safely
problemStatement: Design the classes for an **online brokerage** (like Zerodha or Groww): users hold funds and a portfolio, place buy/sell orders of different types, and watch live prices.
title: Design an Online Stock Brokerage System
